title: Excellent doctors and staff
content: I was overwhelmed by the excellent care and attention I was given by the GP I saw yesterday. Every doctor I have seen at this surgery has been exemplary in their professionalism and diagnostic skills, and their tremendous empathy. The receptionists and nurses are great, too. I highly recommend this practice.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
